chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah, from his father (peace be upon him), said:
The boy does not become capable of impregnation until his breasts are rounded and the smell of his armpits rises.

key_terms.يُلْقَحُ: He is impregnated/becomes capable of impregnation

ai.seo_question: What are the physical signs of male puberty in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the physical markers of male puberty (bulugh) within Shia fiqh, linking biological development to the onset of legal responsibility (taklif). It reflects the scholarly tradition of using observable physiological changes, such as breast development and armpit odor, to determine when a boy is no longer a minor in matters of religious obligation.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, from Abu Abdullah, 
(It has been narrated) from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The boy cannot impregnate until his breasts are rounded, and the smell of his armpits rises’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has narrated from his father, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who has said, that
a boy cannot impregnate until his breast becomes round and the smell of his armpit rises strong.’”
